AEA R84 dealer pages and the AEA one-sheet, read through a search summary 2026-11-12 (the PDF was too large to fetch): a passive ribbon microphone with a captive cable of about 3 m ending in an XLR-3 male; no phantom power. The captive-cable end is modelled as an XLR on the base of the body. The oval lathe profile (a 50 mm round body under a 99 x 64 mm ribbon head) is an estimate drawn from the outer size, no photo or drawing opened. 99 x 64 x 295 mm (datasheet, size ok). Generic artwork only (content/generic-panels/<id>.json, drawn by npm run asset:panel): connectors, knobs and indicators drawn at the port positions, no photo, no logo, no lettering. Every port and control position is a guess (confidence guess): no drawing or photo was opened.
